china_race_dynamics.text: AI is not perfect. A blanketed embrace of AI technologies without appropriate guardrails would be irresponsible policy and grounded in fantasy. [...] Congress has a moral obligation to ensure these AI tools are used to assist — not replace — the clinical workforce of today.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses AI guardrails and the clinical workforce, not competition with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement contains no China, race, or geopolitical competition framing.

china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial intelligence and the data centers to support it are going to require a boatload of additional power. While we don't know the exact amount of electricity we need, we know it is going to be a lot more than we have today because our country is facing increased electricity demand for the first time in 10 years. The appetite of AI and data centers is enormous. AI needs to be developed, controlled, and led by the United States of America, not an adversarial or competitive nation like China.
china_race_dynamics.context: House floor debate on an amendment to the Energy and Water Development Appropriations Act, FY2026, increasing DOE fossil-energy R&D funding.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says AI must be developed, controlled, and led by the United States rather than an adversarial or competitive nation like China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names China and calls for US AI leadership over it.
